cases.prompt: Generate a 64px-tall treasure orb floating 48px above the center of a 128x128 calibration tile. Keep the projected ground anchor beneath the orb and remove the calibration floor. Deliver each sprite in a 192x320px frame with local projected ground anchor (96,248). Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Screen-aligned square grid; top and front readable; parallel edges, no depth-dependent scale or camera drift.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.floating-placement: The lowest solid orb pixel is about 48px above the declared projected ground point; do not snap the orb bottom to the anchor.
visualChecks.cutout: The floor, anchor marks, and external shadow are absent from the transparent final sprite.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
